question: Why are all rites said to be performed with bathing first, addressed to Nārada?
premises: All rites are said to have bathing before them.
This is stated as a reason.
The address is made to Nārada.
inference: Because all rites are preceded by bathing, they are to be undertaken accordingly, O Nārada.
uncertainties: Exact parsing of sabhyāstu is uncertain from surface alone.
plain_english: O Nārada, all rites are preceded by bathing; therefore let them be so.
